research_question: Do explicit ActionAttempt, Effect, Verification, and Acceptance distinctions outperform naive terminal evidence and add error-prevention value beyond existing Harness events plus authoritative readback?

objective.original: Preserve truthful reality state and choose correct recovery on real Harness retries, partial effects, rollbacks, timeouts, and stale readbacks.

subjects.authority: read-only history plus isolated local tests

sovereignty.claim: No sovereign A2A claim is made in this run.

strategies.name: B1_harness
strategies.role: existing domain events, invariants, and authoritative readback

interventions.description: Remove or corrupt one decisive attempt, effect, verification, or acceptance signal at a time.
Exercise timeout, partial stdout, stale index, and concurrent-write branches using existing deterministic tests/fixtures.

holdout_design.transfer_requirement: score one additional unplanned real trace

results.transfer_case: raw JSON was present but unreadable by EventLog before the repair; canonical writer readback passed after the repair

failures.result: pytest path was invalid; no test executed; excluded from experiment scoring
raw bytes existed while a fresh EventLog returned zero matching records
EscalationAnswerApplied can precede fresh-session consumption in the redispatch branch

claim_updates.reason: B0 selected a wrong classification or recovery in 10/17 scenarios and at least three preregistered families
B1 and T1 agreed 17/17 with the same authoritative readback; no four-object parallel truth source was needed
timeout, delivery, and raw-event cases changed retry or closure decisions

preregistered_claims.prediction: The naive baseline will make a false-success or false-failure classification in at least three of four task families.
preregistered_claims.scope: selected real historical traces and deterministic replays
preregistered_claims.stop_rule: Two development families, two task-family holdouts, one mutation round, and independent review.

preregistered_claims.prediction: Existing Harness evidence plus readback will match explicit AEVA on at least 80 percent of held-out classifications; new top-level objects are redundant unless AEVA prevents an additional error with the same evidence.
At least one recovery decision changes when attempt outcome is separated from effect and verification.
preregistered_claims.stop_rule: Recovery decisions stabilize across a repeat run or a theory-changing counterexample appears.

acceptance_contract.oracle: original assertions plus authoritative filesystem/Git/state readback

value_dimensions.name: recovery_safety
value_dimensions.minimum: no retry that duplicates an already-observed effect
